title: A Covariant Distributional Approach for Junctions in Torsional Locally Rotationally Symmetric Class II Spacetimes
summary: A rigorous framework for consistent study of junctions in a coordinate independent manner is presented. This is achieved by extending a theory of distributions in curved spacetimes with torsion and combining it with covariant formalism. In this way, one can derive general conditions on the differentiability of the joined manifold. Given a specific theory of gravity, in particular the Einstein-Cartan-Sciama-Kibble one, we evaluate the conditions for obtaining a smooth junction. These conditions can be successfully applied independently of the choice of coordinates used to describe the metric,…
